sentences.text:
Petition under Section 151 CPC is filed praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed in support of the writ petition, the High Court may be pleased to direct the Respondents particularly Respondent No.4 to 6 not to interfere in any manner with possession of petitioner over any portion of his land much less Ac. 0.15 Cents out of total extent Ac. 1.67 Cents comprising Ac.0.58 Cents and Ac.1.09 Cents  respectively covered by Sy. No's 144-B and 145 of 43-Udegolam Village,
Kanenkal Mandal, Anantapuramu District, pending disposal of WP.No.23646 of 2025, on the file of the High Court.
 The petition coming on for hearing, upon perusing the Petition and the affidavit filed in support thereof and upon hearing the arguments of Sri Pala Karthi Kiran, Advocate for the Petitioner and GP for Revenue for the Respondent Nos.1 to 4 and GP for Home for the Respondent No.5 and GP for Irrigation for the Respondent No.6, the Court made the following;
ORDER:

"It is the grievance of the petitioner that the respondent authorities, despite available alternatives,
are digging the canal in the petitioner's land without acquisition or paying compensation.

Learned State Counsel has placed the proceedings, dated 04.09.2025, addressed by the respondent/Tahsildar and that the relevant portion is extracted, which reads that "Finally it is submitted that neither the Tahsildar, Kanekal nor his officers have not visited the agricultural fields for the excavation of canal over the writ petitioner's fields and no land acquisition process has been initiated over the subject land.
More over as per the Google maps have also confirmed that there are two parallel cancels are passing from south side of Sy.No.143 through 144, 145 & 105 since from 30 years.
But the writ petitioner with ill feelings has approached this Hon'ble High Court, where he was obstructed the parallel canal which was flowing from last 30 years.

"
